scene_cards.dramatic_function: Establishes Julian's discovery of the hidden correspondence channel inside his work locker.

char_julian.goal: Julian seeks to save enough money to leave the city and open a joinery shop in Hull with his sister Clara.

required_beats: Julian unpacks his day-shift kit into locker b 14, testing the stiff lock and accidentally displacing the loose ventilation louver.
From under the bottom shelf, Julian pulls out a blue tin cigar box containing a florid handwritten poetic note addressed to whoever shares the tin box.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Establishes the strict operational curfew threatening any unauthorized overlap between shifts.
required_beats: Supervisor Gable inspects the day porters on the cold loading dock, warning them against lingering between shifts under strict winter handover rules.
Gable announces that any day porter found on hospital property past the six o'clock shift lockout faces disciplinary suspension.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Establishes Julian's financial stakes and deadline regarding the shared workshop lease.
required_beats: Clara confronts Julian outside the dispatch office, warning that their Hull landlord will forfeit the workshop lease if his deposit installment is late.
Julian pats the cash envelope in his coat and promises to deliver his remaining portion before the month ends.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Turns Julian from a curious discoverer into an active participant in an anonymous correspondence.

char_julian.goal: Julian seeks to build a savings cushion for his move to Hull while enduring the winter shift.
Julian seeks to connect with the mysterious night writer through locker B-14.

required_beats: Julian writes a letter confessing his exhaustion and his dream of woodworking on the coast, believing his locker mate is a cultured surgical technician.
Julian slides the letter into the cigar box and shuts locker b 14 before the evening lockout.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To threaten Neil's correspondence by revealing Gary originated the gag, forcing Neil to plead for Gary's silence.

char_neil.goal: Neil seeks to endure the night porter shift quietly while paying down inherited family debt.
Neil seeks to maintain the correspondence with Julian without exposing his ordinary identity.

required_beats: Gary catches Neil reading Julian's letter in the boiler room and recognizes the handwriting, mocking him for answering a locker gag.
Neil pleads with Gary not to shatter the connection, and Gary promises to keep quiet.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To introduce a looming deadline and risk of exposure to the correspondence through an upcoming contraband sweep.
required_beats: Supervisor Gable inspects padlocks during a patrol of the basement locker room and catches Neil lingering by locker b 14 before his night route.
Gable warns Neil that all locks will be bolt-clipped during an upcoming sweep scheduled for the following week.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To show Julian deepening his attachment by leaving an intimate handmade gift in the hidden drop.

char_julian.status: exhausted from double shifts but emotionally invested

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To dramatize the agonizing contrast between Neil's grim physical reality and Julian's idealized perception of him.
required_beats: Neil hauls heavy solvent drums alone into the holding alcove beneath humming pipes in the boiler substation.
Touching the carved cedar bird in his coat, Neil is overwhelmed by guilt over not being the refined technician Julian imagines.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To expose Neil's true identity and end his deception by leaving behind the truth for Julian.

char_neil.goal: Neil seeks to maintain the correspondence with Julian without exposing his ordinary identity.
Neil seeks to confess his true identity to Julian before supervisor sweeps discover the notes.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To force Julian to retrieve the secret cache seconds before Gable's raid destroys their line of contact.
required_beats: Supervisor Gable marches into the basement locker room with maintenance staff carrying bolt cutters.
Julian reaches through the loose louver of the basement locker to extract the cigar box and hide it inside his jacket just before Gable reaches locker B-14.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To cost Julian his position when he risks everything to intercept his anonymous correspondent.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To force Julian to sacrifice his long-planned escape to Hull in order to confront his real feelings in the city.

char_julian.goal: Julian seeks the truth about who authored the notes.
Julian seeks to decide whether to leave for Hull or remain to confront his feelings for Neil.

required_beats: Clara arrives at dispatch with the final Hull workshop agreement and demands the savings envelope.
Julian realizes leaving would be running from reality and confesses he cannot go.

voice_card.register: light, digressive, fond of its own asides
voice_card.sentence_rhythm: springy sentences with parenthetical swerves; frequent dashes
voice_card.dialogue_density: high; characters talk over each other and the narrator enjoys it

metadata.title: The Slat in Locker Fourteen
metadata.source: segmented from a Fabula-only package by gemini-3.8-flash

facts.statement: Gary Vance planted an overly dramatic romantic letter in locker B-14 before transferring shifts as a practical joke on the incoming porters.
Neil Hallowell was assigned the night-shift share of locker B-14 in the basement locker room.
Neil Hallowell concealed his identity as an uncredentialed night porter and sustained the romantic correspondence started by Gary.
The bottom metal louver of locker B-14's ventilation grille is unbolted and can be slid aside without unlocking the padlock.
Hospital administration strictly forbids off-shift porters from remaining on hospital premises past shift handover under threat of immediate disciplinary dismissal.
Clara Miller signed a commercial lease for a joinery shop in Hull that requires Julian's matching cash deposit before the final day of January.
Julian has accumulated nearly the full deposit sum inside a relocation envelope to join his sister Clara in Hull.
Julian believed his correspondent was a seasoned senior technician who shared his poetic disposition and loneliness.
Supervisor Gable scheduled a comprehensive locker inspection to confiscate contraband and cut unauthorized padlocks.
Julian placed a hand-carved cedar wren inside the shared tin cigar box as a token of devotion for the night writer.
Neil is assigned the solitary 02:00 chemical solvent transport route through the hazardous basement boiler substation.
Neil wrote an unvarnished confession letter explaining his real identity and sincere feelings to be placed in the tin box.
Julian rescued the tin cigar box through the loose locker louver before Supervisor Gable's inspection team arrived.
Supervisor Gable placed Julian on disciplinary suspension after catching him on hospital grounds after his shift had ended.
Julian experienced profound betrayal upon learning that the correspondence began as a workplace prank.

premise.logline: Two hospital porters on opposite shifts fall for each other through notes left in a shared locker, and one of them is not who the notes suggest.

modules.theme: whether you can love someone you have only ever read
modules.setting_time: a hard winter of staff shortages
modules.setting_place: a large city hospital, its basements and loading bays
modules.protagonist: a day porter saving to leave the city
modules.protagonist_want: to meet the night porter without ruining it
modules.antagonism: a rota that never lets them overlap, and a supervisor who reads the notes
modules.complication: the notes were started by someone else, as a joke
modules.ending_shape: they meet as themselves and choose each other anyway

plot_shape.name: Courtship
plot_shape.central_question: What has to be given up for these two to be honest with each other?

phases.name: Two worlds
phases.purpose: Both parties established separately, each with a commitment in the way.

phases.name: Collision
phases.purpose: Forced proximity; a misjudgement each makes about the other.

phases.name: Concealment
phases.purpose: Something true is withheld, for a reason that is not cowardice.

phases.name: Exposure
phases.purpose: The withheld thing surfaces at the worst available moment.

phases.name: Terms
phases.purpose: What each actually gives up, stated plainly.

cast_roles.purpose: Withholds something, and has a good reason.
A person embodying what one of them owes elsewhere.
Knows the withheld thing and is bound not to say it.

obligatory_moves: The reader learns the withheld thing before the second party does.
The misjudgement is reasonable given what that character has been shown.
Neither party gets what they wanted without naming what it costs.
